result.description:
About us

We’re not like other digital marketing companies.

We are a consulting-led agency. What does that mean? It means our sole focus is driving profitable growth for our client’s business.
It means we are platform and channel-agnostic. We look at where clients want to go and tell them the best way to get there, even if that means taking a road less travelled.

We work with some of the world’s best-known companies, including innovative scale-ups, large global brands and private equity firms, to deliver visionary yet pragmatic solutions to their unique challenges.

We (and our clients!) consider us experts in: media buying & advertising, creative, SEO, social media management, content, web analytics & attribution, website development, conversion rate optimization and UX/ UI consulting. We use our expertise and skills to help our clients drive fast profitable growth for their business.

We service clients in Australia and the US with most of us based in our Sydney office and some key team members working remotely around the world. We are currently operating on a hybrid model with Tuesdays and Thursdays in the office.

Our company culture is one of innovation, diversity and excellence. Most importantly, we genuinely care about each other, which makes working at Orange Line that much better!


About the role

Reporting to the Paid Media Manager, the Senior Paid Media Executive will help look after
our high-growth client portfolio.

You will specifically be involved in delivering cutting-edge strategies across a spectrum of
paid channels such as Search, Social, Programmatic, Lead Generation & Mobile, with a focus
on optimising results. Reporting will also be a big part of the role, so numbers shouldn’t faze
you.

This is the perfect opportunity if you’re looking to gain hands-on experience in digital
marketing whilst working with prestigious clients, and essentially broaden your skillset and
learn the execution of new channels.

You will be responsible for

- Management of digital campaigns including setup, reporting & optimisation
- Support managers at client weekly meetings and present key learnings and action items
- Management of existing accounts & campaigns, with best practice application, budget management, reconciliation and testing
- Delivery of campaign reporting with the support of our reporting specialists
- Provide insight, analysis and guidance to client and team on campaign optimisation and opportunities
- Use of 3rd party tools including Bid Management platforms and Ad Servers
- Create media plans and provide spend forecasts
- Liaise with 3rd party providers to resolve any issues as they arise
- Proactively contribute to team meetings & knowledge sharing


About you

- 3+ years’ experience in Paid Search or Paid Social is crucial
- Experience across other paid channels is desired but not essential
- Reporting / analytical - comfortable with numbers and data
- Strong skill set across Microsoft Excel
- Experience working on performance-focused clients is desired but not essential
- Confidence & proven results in implementing optimisations to drive the desired outcome
- Clear communicator and innovative thinker
- Commitment to staying ahead of industry trends & an eagerness to learn
- Logical and analytical approach to problem-solving
- Effective and efficient working style
- Take pride in your work and care about the people around you because we are a family-oriented agency


What's in it for you

- Awesome office located 15 minutes walk to/from Central Station
- Orange Line is a company that believes in work/life harmony and flexibility
- Permanent hybrid model with Mon/Wed/Fri working from home and Tue/Thu in the office
- You will receive excellent avenues for learning & development. We set clear goals and milestones: so when we grow, you grow.
- You will work with a mix of brands and industries here in Australia and internationally
- Work alongside subject-matter experts who've been working at that level for years, giving you breadth of knowledge and experience
- Monthly organised social events, like brewery tours, boat parties, cheese making - and maybe you can suggest the next one!
- We are super inclusive and are open to everyone and everything. Have a say in the team, the culture, and the agency as a whole

result.description:
Carpenter – Full-Time
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $80,000 – $110,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking experienced and motivated Carpenters to join our growing team on a full-time basis.
About the Role

As a Carpenter, you will be responsible for constructing, installing, repairing, and maintaining timber and metal structures used across mining, industrial, commercial, and construction projects. You will work closely with supervisors, engineers, and other trades to ensure all carpentry work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project specifications and Australian Standards.

Key Responsibilities
•	Read and interpret construction drawings, plans, blueprints, and specifications.
•	Measure, cut, shape, assemble, and install timber, plywood, steel framing, and other building materials.
•	Construct, install, and repair formwork, flooring, walls, ceilings, partitions, doors, windows, and roofing components.
•	Install fixtures, fittings, cladding, handrails, stairs, and other structural components.
•	Carry out maintenance and repair work on existing buildings, structures, and site facilities.
•	Operate hand tools, power tools, and woodworking machinery safely and efficiently.
•	Ensure all carpentry work complies with building codes, project specifications, and workplace safety requirements.
•	Inspect completed work to ensure high-quality workmanship and compliance with quality standards.
•	Work collaboratively with supervisors, engineers, and other tradespeople to complete projects within required timeframes.
•	Maintain accurate records of work completed, materials used, and maintenance activities where required.
•	Assist in mentoring apprentices and junior carpenters.
•	Follow all workplace health and safety policies, procedures, and environmental requirements.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1–2 years of full-time experience as a Carpenter or in a similar carpentry role.
•	Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and technical specifications.
•	Strong knowledge of carpentry techniques, building materials, and construction methods.
•	Experience using hand tools, power tools, and woodworking equipment.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team in industrial, commercial, or construction environments.
•	Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
•	Commitment to workplace safety and quality workmanship.
•	Excellent communication and organisational skills.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $80,000 – $110,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, industrial, and construction projects.
•	Ongoing training and career development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.
result.title: Carpenter

result.description:
Objective
	To be a key part of the Seafarers Centre teams in North Tasmania with primary responsibility of setting up a sustainable centre and team in Devonport and providing administrative support to ensure the smooth running of the Mission to Seafarers in Bell Bay and Burnie. 

Level of Responsibility	The incumbent reports directly to the Regional Director of Mission to Seafarers Australia (VIC based) while maintaining a close working relationship with the committee members of Tasmania and takes responsibility for the recruitment, training and in Devonport rostering of volunteers.

The day to day operations of the Devonport centre including financial. 

Conditions:	Required to maintain Safe Church Communities endorsement, including a Working with Vulnerable People card.  Drivers Licence 


This role would suit someone who is passionate about helping seafarers and volunteers, who is flexible, well organised and innovative. 


Knowledge / convictions
The candidate should have excellent communication and interpersonal skills and be confident with technology, particularly with a fluent working knowledge of Microsoft Office software, accounting software, and basic web skills to update webpages and manage social media platforms. 
Essential Skills and experiences
•	Office administration experience 
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
•	Proficient in the use of MS Office products and accounting software (incl xero)
•	Experience or demonstrated capacity to coordinate volunteers 
Desirable Skills and experiences
•	Experience of minute taking and preparation of financial reports
•	Website management and social media skills 
•	An understanding of the aims and objectives of the Mission to Seafarers
•	Marketing and Public Relations skills 
•	Fundraising experience 
Duties and Responsibilities
1.	Administrative support 
a.	Compiling agenda and management committee meeting minutes 
b.	Completion and collation of Australian Border Force (ABF) documentation
c.	Maintaining annual registration documentation including charities registration, permits, essential contacts lists
d.	Monitor and acknowledge incoming donations (financial and in-kind) and relevant correspondence 
e.	Providing administrative and practical support to the Chairs, Secretary's, Treasurers, Public Officers, and Ships Visitor Officer.
f.	Manage the supply of Sim Cards and Top-ups for seafarers
g.	Arrange Foreign Currency exchange and reporting
h.	Assisting the Regional Director when requested

2.	Communications and Marketing 
a.	Monitor incoming communications and direct/distribute accordingly 
b.	Coordinate internal communications for the day to day running of the centre i.e roster of volunteers, bus pickups, liaison with shipping agents, TasPorts for Devonport
c.	Act as a key liaison between the MtS and external bodies such as the Anglican Diocese of Tasmania, parish churches, Tas Ports and other relevant bodies
d.	Management of the website and social media platforms 
e.	Coordinating the creation and distribution of creative marketing content to raise the profile of the Mission to Seafarers state-wide 
3.	Volunteer management 
a.	Working with the committees to recruit and train volunteers 
b.	Maintain volunteer contact details and roster for Devonport
c.	Coordinating volunteer permits and licencing including (but not limited to) Working with Vulnerable People card, First Aid training, Ship and Port access training and other relevant training as per the Australian council obligations.
4.	Attendance:
a.	MtS Conferences interstate
b.	Committee meetings in person or via teleconference
c.	Devonport centre as requested by seafarers.
 
The position is currently funded for 3 days per week - days and hours to be negotiated. 
Training across many areas can be completed on the job.
The role would suit someone with at least 6 years work experience and/ or is returning to work.

Overview: 

Reofast supplies, fabricates and installs reinforcing steel for premium residential builders across Perth, taking projects from take-off and quotation through to fabrication, delivery and installation. The business is committed to delivering high-quality reinforcement solutions through accuracy, efficiency and exceptional customer service.

We are seeking an experienced Construction Estimator to join our team in Perth, WA. In this role, you will be responsible for analysing structural and architectural drawings, preparing quantity take-offs and cost estimates, and developing reinforcement schedules and bar lists to support the accurate supply, fabrication and delivery of reinforcement steel products. This is a full-time ongoing position working 38 hours per week.


Main tasks:

-	Analysing structural and architectural drawings to determine reinforcement steel requirements for construction projects.
-	Preparing detailed quantity take-offs and cost estimates for steel supply, fabrication and delivery.
-	Developing reinforcement schedules and bar lists to ensure quantities align with structural and engineering drawings.
-	Preparing pricing breakdowns for materials, fabrication and logistics to support quotations and tender submissions.
-	Coordinating with structural engineers, architects, builders, site teams and suppliers to confirm project requirements, quantities and pricing.
-	Reviewing project variations and updating estimates, quantities and costs accordingly.
-	Preparing marked-up drawings and maintaining accurate estimating information across internal software systems.
-	Managing workload, priorities and deadlines to ensure quotations and reinforcement schedules are completed on time.
-	Liaising with clients and builders to ensure estimating is based on the latest project documentation.
-	Monitoring stock levels and assisting with supplier orders as required.
-	Maintaining accurate estimating records and reports.
-	Performing any additional duties as required from time to time.


Required/Relevant Qualifications & Work Experience:

-	Relevant qualification in Construction, Building, Engineering or a related discipline.
-	Alternatively, at least five years of relevant construction estimating experience may substitute for the formal qualification.


Required/Relevant Skills & Knowledge:

-	Strong communication skills with clients, staff and site tradespersons.
-	High attention to detail and accuracy.
-	Ability to read and interpret structural and architectural drawings.
-	Sound understanding of construction site operations and project requirements.
-	Ability to prepare accurate reinforcement schedules within required timeframes.
-	Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage priorities, workloads and deadlines.
-	Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with clients and suppliers.
-	Solutions-focused with a proactive and can-do attitude.
-	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Notion and Slack.
-	Ability to maintain accurate estimating records and reports.


 Annual salary will be between $90,000.00 to $110,000.00 (plus superannuation) depending on level of experience.

Seven Corp on behalf of Adelaide Steel Frame Windows

Overview: 

Adelaide Steel Frame Windows is South Australia’s largest manufacturer of architectural steel doors and windows. Operating successfully for over 24 years, our continued growth has led to a recent expansion into a larger facility in Regency Park. We take immense pride in our craftsmanship, solid work ethic, and supportive team culture.

We are seeking a dedicated, full-time Metal Machinist / CNC Specialist to join our production team. In this role, your primary responsibility will be setting up, programming, and operating precision tools and machinery to shape high-tolerance steel components for our bespoke architectural doors and windows.

This position is ideal for a precision-focused tradesperson with comprehensive experience in both complex manual milling and turning operations alongside advanced CNC programming. Working alongside our workshop floor team, you will enhance productivity, ensure strict quality control, troubleshoot manufacturing challenges, and assist in mentoring apprentice team members.

Main Tasks:

-	Interpret complex technical drawings, blueprints, and engineering specifications to determine job requirements, tooling needs, and sequence of machining operations.
-	 Set up, program, and operate a variety of machine tools including CNC processing machines, lathes, milling machines, and precision grinders to shape steel components.
-	Calculate engineering parameters, feed rates, and cutting speeds; check fabricated components for conformity and extreme precision using micrometers, calipers, and gauges.
-	Embrace daily tradesperson challenges to diagnose, troubleshoot, and enhance overall machining and manufacturing processes.
-	Work closely alongside the workshop floor team to achieve optimal assembly timeframes, minimise material wastage, and maintain high-quality project outcomes.


Required/Relevant Qualifications & Work Experience:

-	Minimum AQF Certificate III in Engineering - Mechanical Trade (Machining)
-	A minimum of one year of full-time proven professional experience setting up, programming, and operating both CNC and manual metalworking machinery, or
-	At least 3 years of relevant experience as a Metal Machinist to substitute the formal qualification.
-	Forklift license 
-	White card
-	Current driver’s license.

Required/Relevant Skills & Knowledge:

-	Demonstrated ability to write, edit, and optimise CNC programs (G-code/M-code or conversational) at the machine control panel.
-	High proficiency in traditional manual turning, milling, drilling, and surface grinding techniques.
-	Advanced skill in using precision measuring instruments (micrometers, height gauges, dial indicators, calipers) to hold tight tolerances.
-	Sound understanding of metal properties (specifically structural and architectural steel grades), insert selection, speeds, feeds, and coolant applications.
-	Strong spatial awareness and ability to convert complex 2D/3D engineering drawings into finished physical components.
-	Strong diagnostic skills for troubleshooting machining chatter, tool wear, and alignment issues.
-	Pride in producing clean, accurate, and repeatable craftsmanship suited for premium architectural applications.

If you are a motivated, Metal Machinist looking to become a critical part of our leading steel frame manufacturing business, please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your machinery experience, CNC programming capabilities, and alignment with our team values via the application link.

Annual salary will be between $75,000.00 to $85,000.00 (plus superannuation) depending on level of experience.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Job Title: 		Metal Fabricator

About the Role
On behalf of our client - a leading structural steel fabricator specialising in commercial, industrial, and infrastructure projects - we are seeking an experienced Metal Fabricator. The company operates a state-of-the-art facility with advanced CNC, plasma cutting, and automated welding equipment, delivering precision-engineered steelwork for high-profile builds. This role is critical to maintaining their reputation for quality, safety, and on-time delivery.

Key Duties & Responsibilities
Preparation & Planning
• Interpret complex blueprints, shop drawings, and specifications to determine material requirements, weld symbols, and assembly sequences.
• Conduct material take-offs and plan efficient cutting layouts to minimise waste, liaising with detailers and project managers.

Cutting & Shaping
• Operate CNC plasma cutters, oxy-fuel torches, and band saws to cut structural steel sections (beams, columns, channels) to precise dimensions.
• Shape and bend metal sections and pipes using hydraulic presses, rollers, and manual methods (heating, hammering) to achieve required profiles.

Assembly & Joining
• Align and tack components using clamps, jigs, and measuring instruments (levels, squares, tape measures) to ensure dimensional accuracy.
• Join steel sections via flux-cored arc welding (FCAW), MIG, or stick welding, as well as bolting and riveting for field connections.

Finishing & Quality Control
• Inspect welds for bead width, penetration, and uniformity; perform non-destructive testing (visual, dye penetrant) as required.
• Grind, file, and polish welds and surfaces to specified finish; apply protective coatings or acid washes to prevent corrosion.

Essential Qualifications & Experience
• Certificate III in Engineering - Fabrication Trade or equivalent qualification
• Minimum 2 years' post-apprenticeship experience in metal fabrication and welding within an industrial environment
• Proficiency in reading engineering drawings and using manual/machine tools.
• Strong welding skills (FCAW/MIG) and knowledge of Australian welding standards.
• Commitment to workplace safety and quality assurance.

Essential Skills & Attributes
• Exceptional attention to detail with commitment to producing high-quality craftsmanship
• Strong problem-solving skills with ability to troubleshoot fabrication and welding challenges
• Physical capability to handle heavy materials and work in demanding industrial environments
• Excellent teamwork and communication skills with ability to collaborate effectively with tradespeople and engineers
• Reliability and strong work ethic with commitment to meeting project deadlines and quality standards
• Adaptability to work across diverse projects and willingness to continuously develop technical skills

To Apply
If you are an experienced Metal Fabricator/Welder seeking a permanent role with an industry leader, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications through the application portal.

Please note: We are managing this recruitment process on behalf of our client. All applications will be reviewed by our team before being presented to the client.

result.description:
WELDWORKS PTY LTD is looking for an experienced Welder and/or Boilermaker for our

client's construction industry (residential homes, commercial buildings, and public spaces)

in Sydney. On a full-time basis, you will be part of a multidisciplinary and

well-supported team.



Title: Welder and/or Boilermaker, Full- time position

Salary: A$ 90,000.00 to 98,000.00 plus super

Work Location: In person.



We are looking for applicants who demonstrate the following:



Requirements

- Certificate 3 including 2 years’ experience or Certificate 4 in Engineering-Fabrication

- Trade/(Welding)

- Proven experience as Welder and/or Metal Fabricator for at least 2 years.

- Knowledge of welding techniques and materials.

- Ability to read and interpret blueprints and technical drawings.

- Physical stamina and strength.

- Attention to detail and precision.

- Good communication and teamwork skills.



Excellent problem-solving abilities.

- Welder Responsibilities Cut, shape, and weld metal components using various welding techniques

- Inspect and test welds for quality and compliance

- Repair or replace damaged metal parts

- Maintain welding equipment and follow safety procedures

- Work closely with fabricators and engineers to complete projects on time

- Boilermaker Responsibilities Fabricate, assemble, and install metal structures and equipment

- Read and interpret technical drawings and plans

- Perform welding, cutting, and bending for metal assemblies

- Inspect finished components to ensure compliance with standards

- Conduct maintenance and repairs on metal structures



If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to date

CV. We can schedule in a time to discuss the positions available and what will be best suited to

you.
